_help: Fallback for banks centralbank.watch does not publish probabilities for (it links out to CME FedWatch for the Fed, and omits the RBNZ). Fill hike/hold/cut as percentages plus next_meeting and src. Set "override": true to beat a scraped value. Leave a bank out entirely rather than guessing - a missing expectation is handled, an invented one is not.

USD.src: researched 2026-08-28 post-Warsh Jackson Hole keynote, re-checked 2026-08-30 (no cleaner post-Warsh figure available - FedWatch 403s here, centralbank.watch's new FOMC page JS-renders its numbers, and secondary reporting still quotes the pre-Warsh 58.6% hold / 41.4% hike as of Aug 25). September a coin flip: hike odds jumped to ~46-56% (from ~33-36%) after Warsh called inflation 'concerning', said the Fed has 'work to do' and that rates may need to rise, with no explicit September signal. Holding 50/50 until the 5 Sep jobs and 10 Sep CPI prints move it.

JPY.src: centralbank.watch, read 2026-08-26 - the scraper misses the BoJ block, so this is transcribed by hand until the parser covers it.

NZD.src: researched 2026-08-30 - a 25bp hike to 2.75% is now near-fully priced. Reuters poll: 27 of 31 economists (90%) expect a hike on 2 Sep, the second consecutive one; market-implied odds ~94% (investinglive/FXStreet, 25-30 Aug). Q2 inflation running hot at 3.9% and stronger growth hardened odds from the ~even split seen 27 Aug. Two-thirds of economists see a further hike next quarter, median year-end 3.00%.

CAD.src: bankofcanadaodds.com, read 2026-08-30 (page last-updated 2026-08-29 23:54, policy rate correct at 2.25%). Near-certain hold: hold 99% / hike 1% / cut 0% for the 2 Sep 2026 decision. Consistent with Polymarket's 90% no-change (1 Jul). centralbank.watch has no BoC block and rateprobability.com was previously rejected as stale; this is the first credible current source found. Scores a true ~neutral 3.02, which is the correct reading - the meeting is a priced hold.

_note_CAD: Filled 2026-08-30 from bankofcanadaodds.com after months of no source. If that feed proves unreliable, revert to leaving CAD out - a missing expectation scores a true 0, an invented one corrupts the component.
